rationale: Six-figure funds frozen at the most critical moment for a startup is an unambiguously burning pain. The HN thread documents a live, concrete incident, and the broader pattern of Stripe account closures for startups is extensively corroborated across HN, Reddit, and Indie Hackers with dozens of nearly identical complaints. Willingness-to-pay is implied by the founder already spending on Stripe Atlas and having pre-seed capital; the main validation risk is whether they'll pay for guidance vs. finding free answers on HN, which the scoring already flags.
